question: List the name of students that have attended more than 7 events.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "attendance_with_member" AS WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    trim(split_part(combined_links, '|', 1)) AS event_id,
    trim(split_part(combined_links, '|', 2)) AS member_id
  FROM table_1
)
SELECT
  m.member_id,
  m.first_name,
  m.last_name,
  p.event_id
FROM parsed p
JOIN table_2 m
  ON p.member_id = m.member_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT
  first_name || ' ' || last_name AS student_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) AS events_attended
FROM attendance_with_member
GROUP BY member_id, first_name, last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) > 7
ORDER BY events_attended DESC, student_name ASC
